verdict.rationale: Baseten documents its own stable development, staging and production environments for deployments, plus a model server that behaves the same in development and production. That lets users test on non-production deployments. The evidence never describes a true sandbox with isolated data, or guarantees that testing cannot touch production data or resources, so only the environment-separation part of the story is supported. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox isolation from production data, docs on how environments separate data and credentials, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: They also support stable environments for development, staging, and production.
Package model code, weights, and dependencies with a model server that behaves the same in development and production.
Fast developer loop: Iterate with live reload, skip Docker and Kubernetes configuration, and use a batteries-included serving environment.
